outcome: Admission to the intensive care unit (ICU)
cohort: 727 women diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) between January 1, 2010 and December 31, 2019, from 11 centers across 9 countries.
finding: Machine learning models, utilizing antepartum and perioperative features, effectively predicted the risk of massive blood loss, prolonged hospitalization, and ICU admission in women with PAS.
